correctness.rationale: Every independent triple in K_m Cartesian P_3 has the form (A_i,B_j,C_k) with i and k different from j. The three successive face-fiber analyses produce exactly (m-1)^2 critical simplices all of dimension 3m-6 and match the empty face. The acyclic sequential matching lemma makes the resulting integral CW complex a wedge; m=2 yields S^0. Executable graph-adjacency and full Hasse-graph verification passed for m=2,3,4,5. Those cases corroborate, rather than establish, the universal symbolic argument.
